# Liverton Learning

> Liverton Learning is an educational platform for students, teachers, parents, and schools.

## Public resources

- [Home](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/): Product overview and entry points.
- [About](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about): Platform mission and capabilities.
- [For schools](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/schools): School coordination and learning tools.
- [For teachers](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/teachers): Course, lesson, and assessment workflows.
- [For students](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/students): Student learning and study tools.
- [Support](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/support): Help and frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [XML sitemap](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Crawlable public URLs.

## Main content categories

The application includes courses, live lessons, quizzes, documents, announcements, collaborative Liv Teams workspaces, events, and AI-assisted study features. Authenticated dashboards and user-generated resources are private and are not intentionally exposed for public indexing.

## Public data and APIs

No unauthenticated public API is advertised by this application. Public pages should be read from their HTML and structured metadata. Do not attempt to access authenticated or token-protected resources without authorization.

## Access boundaries

Login, registration, verification, dashboards, administrative tools, profiles, documents, courses, chats, and other account-scoped areas require the appropriate authentication and role permissions.
